posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina delighted fans with her May photo dump featuring unseen birthday celebration pics of Vicky Kaushal and a rare glimpse of baby Vihaan's tiny hands.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali releases June 12, while Sardaar Ji 3 BTS photos with Neeru Bajwa are building massive hype ahead of its June 27 launch.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia and Sharvari have kicked off promotions for Alpha, YRF's first female-led Spy Universe film releasing July 3. Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan cameo rumoured.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka shared glimpses of her relaxing Sunday in Hyderabad amid the ongoing shoot of SS Rajamouli's Varanasi. She's also confirmed for Krrish 4 alongside Hrithik.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action thriller King officially locks Christmas 2026 release. Buzz builds around his rumoured Pathaan cameo in Alia Bhatt's Alpha and a potential big-budget romantic drama.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena welcomed Katrina to the 'Mamma Club' after baby Vihaan's reveal. Jee Le Zaraa with Priyanka and Katrina is progressing with Farhan Akhtar scouting locations.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha continues to reign as Instagram's most-followed Indian actress. Fans eagerly await updates on her next project after the blockbuster Stree 2 franchise.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika officially joined Allu Arjun in Atlee's sci-fi epic AA22xA6 with a BTS announcement video. She's also expecting her second child while filming SRK's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: After Dhurandhar's historic ₹3,100 crore global duology run, Ranveer's post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay with a ₹300 crore budget begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: A 23-year-old dance clip of Aishwarya from an unreleased film has gone viral online. Sai Pallavi has replaced her in Kalki 2 as the sequel moves ahead with Prabhas.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor tops IMDb's most-anticipated Indian film of 2026. Rashmika also joins Allu Arjun's AA22xA6 in a daring new avatar after Pushpa.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha reveals her action comedy Maa Inti Bangaaram was originally planned for Sai Pallavi. She's also in talks for a Raj & DK superhero film opposite Salman Khan.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's sci-fi epic AA22xA6 with Atlee adds Deepika Padukone to a star-studded cast. His collaboration with Lokesh Kanagaraj (AA23) is confirmed still on track.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi smashes ₹150 crore worldwide in just 2 days, beating Dhurandhar and Pathaan's opening records. The AR Rahman-scored sports drama is a box office storm.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR gears up for War 2 with Hrithik Roshan releasing August 14. He's also confirmed for Trivikram's mythological epic about Kartikeya after Allu Arjun's exit.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi faces backlash over Peddi's treatment of her character Achiyamma, with singers and actresses calling out the objectification. She reportedly liked a critical post.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya turned heads in an all-white ethnic look at a Mumbai event, with pearl-detailed net suit and traditional styling going viral on social media.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stole the spotlight at the Nita Ambani Cultural Centre anniversary in a stunning pink saree alongside Sidharth Malhotra. War 2 release on August 14 nears.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik praises Jr NTR as 'simply amazing' ahead of their epic dance-off in War 2 releasing August 14. He's also making his directorial debut with Krrish 4.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released on June 5 as part of Bollywood's biggest month ever with ₹1,400 crore at stake across 9 major releases.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya shared her deeply personal connection to devotional track 'Siddha Bhajo' as a tribute to her father. Her Unstoppable Tour hits Australia this month and the US in September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman's soundtrack for Ram Charan's Peddi is dominating charts as the film crosses ₹150 crore in 2 days. He composed for Main Vaapas Aaunga releasing June 12.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's final film Jananayagan eyes a blockbuster release window as Thalapathy Kacheri hits 2.5M real-time views. His TVK party shook Tamil Nadu's political landscape in state elections.
